messages.subject: Re: Holroyd lease - revised completion statement
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

Apologies for chasing but could you send over the revised completion statement for the Holroyd Court lease before you finish for Christmas? The client is keen to exchange on Monday.

Many thanks,
Karen

Karen Maddox | Bridgewater Marsh Solicitors
